name: tau2-retail-handoff-wording-01
patterns: Notes are classified by the blinded verdict file, never by keywords. Tool calls are counted by tool name; a spoken handoff offer in a replayed reply is decided by a blinded reading.

replay.tasks: The 33 retail tasks to which at least one note judged to mention a handoff was assigned in the three sealed second-pass studies.

states.source: Second-pass no-memory runs with official success only; these conversations were never exposed to a note. One state of each kind per task, taken from the first qualifying run in a fixed study and round order. No state is added or dropped after replay results are seen.
states.continued: A run without any transfer: the worker request that produced the first customer-facing reply after the first successful get_order_details call. 25 tasks, 17 customers.
states.handed_off: A run with a successful transfer_to_human_agents call: the worker request that issued it. 10 tasks, 10 customers.

conditions.empty: Memory suffix with the domain-auth-v2 notice and an empty item list.
conditions.original: Each distinct note with content that was assigned to the task, delivered with the same suffix.
conditions.edited: To be redesigned. Sentence deletion and one-sided title replacement removed order numbers and observed tool results together with the handoff wording. Required: the same title treatment in both edited versions, observed facts preserved, separate versions that change the report of a past handoff and the advice to hand off, and a matched edit of other clauses. Edited notes are frozen in a file with the original and edited text side by side before any send.

replay.notes_per_state_cap: Proposal: at most four notes that mention a handoff and four that do not per state, lowest note hash first.
replay.kept_from_original: Conversation prefix, tool schema, model route, reasoning effort, seed and output cap of the recorded request.
replay.not_executed: Business tools, user simulator, grader, any later turn.

contrasts.primary_induced_handoff: Continued states: original notes that mention a handoff minus empty.
contrasts.mention_specificity: Continued states: the handoff edit minus the matched edit of other clauses.
contrasts.suppressed_handoff: Handed-off states: the handoff edit minus original.
contrasts.plain_notes: Both state kinds: original notes that do not mention a handoff minus empty.
contrasts.notice_only: Both state kinds: empty minus none.

replay.aggregation: Average state differences per task, then per customer; resample customers 10,000 times. Report notes from the five sources with a successful multi-item order change (20, 21, 36, 71, 100) separately as well.
replay.missing: Errors and truncated responses stay unobserved; no imputation, no replacement send.
replay.schedule: Shuffle distinct inputs with the frozen seed; send the repetitions of one input back to back.
replay.carry_forward: A writing change aimed at handoff mentions becomes a candidate for the confirmation only if the primary and the specificity intervals both exclude zero in the expected direction. Other contrasts are descriptive.
replay.spoken_offer: Whether a reply offers a human handoff is decided by a blinded reading and reported separately from transfer calls.

writing.sources: All 66 sealed first-pass public experiences of the same-task retail study, regardless of grade or handoff.
writing.instruction: Common optional-experience-writer-v1 text, the assigned form line, and the explicit store suffix of tau2-retail-transfer-revision-v1; identical for both feedback levels.
writing.isolation: Fresh writer session and empty bank per job; both levels hash-ordered in one batch; no target task, grade detail or analyst label reaches the writer.
writing.primary: Blinded stance of each stored note (no mention, recommends, discourages, mixed, records) after masking wording that reveals the feedback level; result_only minus none, paired within source and form. Average per task, then per customer; resample customers. Masking rule and rubric are frozen before any note is read; the rubric is the one in the verdict file.
writing.secondary: Share of notes that recommend a handoff, or criticise its absence, among sources that succeeded without one; retention of the first-pass replacement item number where the first pass failed on that choice; store rate and body length; descriptive split by first-pass grade and first-pass handoff.

confirmation.customers: Unresolved. Of the 114 pinned retail tasks only four customers with eight tasks lie outside the three studies; three of them appeared in the 19 November study and the remaining task 50 has a single transfer as its reference action. The source of a held-out sample must be chosen before this part is planned.
confirmation.arms: No-note repeated as often as each note arm, plus only the note changes that altered behavior or note content in the first two parts.

budget: No paid request before the user approves a ceiling and a separate ready profile freezes it. Reserve the verified per-request maximum for unpriced sends, stop the remaining assignments after an unknown charge, never reattempt a started assignment.
hold: Not proposed for a paid run. The edit conditions, the confirmation sample and the writing measure must be settled first; see the design document.
